expected_diagnosis: One user process is consuming almost a CPU.
recommended_next_checks: Identify workload, duration, expected task behavior.
resolution_guidance: Coordinate with owner; optimize or reschedule task, avoid blind kill.
verification: User-facing latency recovers and usage normalizes.
production_warning: Không áp dụng lệnh chỉnh sửa trên VPS khách hàng khi chưa có quyền, backup và kế hoạch rollback.
